lines.speaker: npc_arsonist
lines.text: Started a fire trying to make toast.

lines.speaker: npc_arsonist
lines.text: I was just holding it near the stove for moral support.

lines.speaker: npc_builder
lines.text: Built a ladder to nowhere. It goes up. It does not come down.

lines.speaker: npc_builder
lines.text: I live there now. Send sandwiches.

lines.speaker: npc_puncher
lines.text: Accidentally punched a cow while trying to pet it.

lines.speaker: npc_puncher
lines.text: The cow filed a complaint. HR is involved.

lines.speaker: npc_traumatized
lines.text: Called in sick because I got stuck in a doorframe.

lines.speaker: npc_traumatized
lines.text: Two other people tried to walk through at the same time. It was traumatic.

lines.speaker: npc_fallen
lines.text: Fell down a well. Not an important well. Just a decorative one.

lines.speaker: npc_fallen
lines.text: The shame is worse than the injuries.

lines.speaker: npc_accused
lines.text: The goat has accused me of stealing its hat.

lines.speaker: npc_goat_lawyer
lines.text: The goat has produced three witnesses and a very convincing photograph.

lines.speaker: npc_accused
lines.text: That photograph is just the goat standing near a hat.

lines.speaker: npc_goat_lawyer
lines.text: The court will decide whether proximity constitutes intent.

lines.speaker: npc_accused
lines.text: Who appointed you as the goat's lawyer?

lines.speaker: npc_goat_lawyer
lines.text: The goat. It paid me in buttons and an alarming amount of eye contact.

lines.speaker: shepherd
lines.text: The goat has learned to open the grain shed.

lines.speaker: shepherd
lines.text: I tried. It watched me hide the key.

lines.speaker: npc_damp
lines.text: It's raining inside my house again.

lines.speaker: npc_fixer
lines.text: Have you tried fixing the roof?

lines.speaker: npc_damp
lines.text: It is simply my indoor weather now. I do not question it.

lines.speaker: npc_calm
lines.text: Saw a tornado coming. Made a sandwich instead.

lines.speaker: npc_panicker
lines.text: You didn't go to the shelter?

lines.speaker: npc_calm
lines.text: It was a really good sandwich.

lines.speaker: npc_weatherwatcher
lines.text: The rain is falling upward tonight.

lines.speaker: npc_practical
lines.text: Then leave the washing on the ground.

lines.speaker: npc_weatherwatcher
lines.text: It is gathering in the clouds beneath us.

lines.speaker: npc_practical
lines.text: Good. The clouds can do the laundry.

lines.speaker: npc_practical
lines.text: I am frightened of many things. Wet clothes are not making the list.

lines.speaker: rainwatcher
lines.text: Then they have better weather sense than the council.

lines.speaker: npc_aware
lines.text: Pretty sure I saw a loading seam in the mountains yesterday.

lines.speaker: npc_aware
lines.text: I pretended I didn't. We all pretend.

lines.speaker: npc_hoarder
lines.text: I have 47 identical shirts in my inventory.

lines.speaker: npc_hoarder
lines.text: I will defend each one with my life. Do not test me.

lines.speaker: npc_wind
lines.text: This is all I am. I have accepted it.

lines.speaker: npc_thinker
lines.text: Sometimes I stop in the middle of the road and stare at the sky.

lines.speaker: npc_thinker
lines.text: I'm just thinking. The player probably thinks I'm broken too.

lines.speaker: gossip
lines.text: I saw Renffr in the stars…

lines.speaker: skeptic
lines.text: Did anyone else see the sky?

lines.speaker: believer
lines.text: The mark of Renffr… plentiful harvest?

lines.speaker: scholar
lines.text: Did anyone else see the sky?

lines.speaker: npc_echo
lines.text: The valley repeated my name before I said it.

lines.speaker: npc_echo
lines.text: An echo repeats what has already happened.

lines.speaker: npc_skeptic
lines.text: Perhaps you said your name yesterday.

lines.speaker: npc_echo
lines.text: Then why did it sound disappointed?

lines.speaker: npc_skeptic
lines.text: Because even the valley has standards.

lines.speaker: dreamer
lines.text: Do you think clouds remember the valleys they leave?

lines.speaker: practical_one
lines.text: Only if the valley owes them money.

lines.speaker: reveler
lines.text: I entered my turnip in the harvest contest.

lines.speaker: reveler
lines.text: At last, a vegetable that understands presentation.

lines.speaker: npc_humiliated
lines.text: I peed myself because someone was using the bathroom.

lines.speaker: npc_humiliated
lines.text: It was the principle of the thing.

lines.speaker: npc_floor_sleeper
lines.text: Slept on the floor next to a $3000 bed because someone claimed it 0.4 seconds before me.

lines.speaker: npc_pragmatist
lines.text: You could've just... asked them to move?

lines.speaker: npc_floor_sleeper
lines.text: And admit defeat? I have standards.

lines.speaker: npc_hungry
lines.text: Ate raw potatoes for 3 days because the stove was slightly too far from the fridge.

lines.speaker: npc_hungry
lines.text: Four tiles. Might as well be the moon.

lines.speaker: npc_dead
lines.text: Died of starvation surrounded by berries.

lines.speaker: npc_dead
lines.text: I forgot I could eat them without putting them in a crate first. Don't look at me.

lines.speaker: npc_cold
lines.text: The blanket is too small for two people.

lines.speaker: npc_prepared
lines.text: That is why I brought two people.

lines.speaker: npc_cold
lines.text: You brought a second person instead of a second blanket?

lines.speaker: npc_prepared
lines.text: The second person was already here and looked useful.

lines.speaker: npc_cold
lines.text: I am not a heating appliance.

lines.speaker: cook
lines.text: Serve the courage first. The turnips need time.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: I had an accident because someone was in the outhouse.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: It was the principle of the thing.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: Slept on the rug because you took the bed 0.4 seconds before me.

lines.speaker: housemate
lines.text: You could've just asked me to shift over.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: And admit defeat? I have standards.

lines.speaker: hungry_settler
lines.text: Ate raw turnips for two days straight.

lines.speaker: cook
lines.text: The soup kettle was right on the stove!

lines.speaker: hungry_settler
lines.text: Four whole tiles away. Might as well be across the river.

lines.speaker: forager
lines.text: Almost starved to death while standing directly in a berry bush.

lines.speaker: neighbor
lines.text: Why didn't you just eat them?

lines.speaker: forager
lines.text: I forgot I could eat without putting them in a storage crate first.

lines.speaker: housemate
lines.text: Stew is simmering in the pot.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: Best part of the entire day.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: The kettle is whistling on the stove.

lines.speaker: housemate
lines.text: Pour a cup before the embers burn down.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: Nothing beats a quiet evening under a solid roof.

lines.speaker: hungry_settler
lines.text: The pantry cupboards are echoing with emptiness.

lines.speaker: pantry_keeper
lines.text: We're rationing the dried beans until the harvest.

lines.speaker: hungry_settler
lines.text: Send word to the hunters before we start boiling leather.

lines.speaker: expectant_mother
lines.text: The baby is kicking up a storm tonight.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: I finished carving the cradle by the window.

lines.speaker: expectant_mother
lines.text: Soon we won't be sleeping through the night for a year.

lines.speaker: cook
lines.text: What is in the stew tonight?

lines.speaker: cook
lines.text: Serve the courage first. The turnips need time.

lines.speaker: npc_chicken_friend
lines.text: My best friend is a chicken. His name is Greg.

lines.speaker: npc_chicken_friend
lines.text: He named himself. I just respected his choice.

lines.speaker: npc_host
lines.text: Threw a party. Nobody came. The cake rotted.

lines.speaker: npc_host
lines.text: I ate it anyway. 5/10, would grief again.

lines.speaker: npc_invested
lines.text: Spent 6 hours building a friendship with someone.

lines.speaker: npc_invested
lines.text: We're both scheduled to leave the map tomorrow. I want a refund.

lines.speaker: npc_invested
lines.text: You keep saying you don't care, but you repaired my roof before the storm.

lines.speaker: npc_cynical
lines.text: I repaired the roof because replacing you would have taken longer.

lines.speaker: npc_invested
lines.text: Then why did you leave your coat on my chair?

lines.speaker: npc_cynical
lines.text: Because you were shivering. Don't turn a practical decision into a confession.

lines.speaker: npc_invested
lines.text: I won't. But tomorrow, if you disappear, I'm coming after you.

lines.speaker: npc_cynical
lines.text: That's the problem. I know you mean it.

lines.speaker: npc_invested
lines.text: The council's missing ledger was in your room. Tell me you didn't take it.

lines.speaker: npc_cynical
lines.text: I didn't take it from the council.

lines.speaker: npc_invested
lines.text: That is a very careful answer. Where did you get it?

lines.speaker: npc_cynical
lines.text: You don't want the truth. You want a version that lets you keep defending me.

lines.speaker: npc_invested
lines.text: I want to know whether the guards are looking for the wrong person.

lines.speaker: npc_invested
lines.text: And you know who they should be looking for?

lines.speaker: npc_cynical
lines.text: I know who will be hurt if they find out. That is not the same thing.

lines.speaker: npc_invested
lines.text: You promised me you wouldn't make me choose between the settlement and you.

lines.speaker: npc_cynical
lines.text: I promised you nothing. You heard what you needed to hear.

lines.speaker: npc_gossip
lines.text: People say you have been meeting someone behind the old mill.

lines.speaker: npc_recluse
lines.text: People say many things because silence makes them nervous.

lines.speaker: npc_recluse
lines.text: I deny that the old mill is behind anything. It is clearly beside the river.

lines.speaker: npc_gossip
lines.text: That is not the denial I asked for.

lines.speaker: npc_recluse
lines.text: Then ask a question you are prepared to hear answered.

lines.speaker: neighbor
lines.text: No. It looks better dressed than I do.

lines.speaker: npc_laborer
lines.text: I've been carrying this rock for 3 hours. I don't know where to put it.

lines.speaker: npc_bystander
lines.text: Have you tried... setting it down?

lines.speaker: npc_laborer
lines.text: I am one with the rock now. Do not interrupt our journey.

lines.speaker: npc_farmer
lines.text: Just watched a guy harvest an entire field by walking diagonally through it.

lines.speaker: npc_veteran
lines.text: We don't talk about the diagonal walk.

lines.speaker: npc_farmer
lines.text: I tried it once. They found my body in a fence.

lines.speaker: npc_clockmaker
lines.text: The clock tower struck thirteen. I think it is asking for overtime.

lines.speaker: npc_night_guard
lines.text: It has been asking for overtime since I started talking to it.

lines.speaker: npc_night_guard
lines.text: Only on nights when it lies about the hour.

lines.speaker: npc_clockmaker
lines.text: Then we agree the machinery is malfunctioning.

lines.speaker: npc_night_guard
lines.text: No. We agree it knows exactly what it is doing.

lines.speaker: fencer
lines.text: I repaired this fence twice today.

lines.speaker: fencer
lines.text: No. It moved while I was looking for my hammer.

lines.speaker: npc_chicken_friend
lines.text: My best friend is a chicken. His name is Greg.

lines.speaker: npc_chicken_friend
lines.text: He named himself. I just respected his choice.

lines.speaker: npc_humiliated
lines.text: I peed myself because someone was using the bathroom.

lines.speaker: npc_humiliated
lines.text: It was the principle of the thing.

lines.speaker: npc_laborer
lines.text: I've been carrying this rock for 3 hours. I don't know where to put it.

lines.speaker: npc_laborer
lines.text: I am one with the rock now. Do not interrupt our journey.

lines.speaker: npc_arsonist
lines.text: Started a fire trying to make toast.

lines.speaker: npc_arsonist
lines.text: I was just holding it near the stove for moral support.

lines.speaker: npc_aware
lines.text: Pretty sure I saw a loading seam in the mountains yesterday.

lines.speaker: npc_aware
lines.text: I pretended I didn't. We all pretend.

lines.speaker: npc_damp
lines.text: It's raining inside my house again.

lines.speaker: npc_damp
lines.text: It is simply my indoor weather now. I do not question it.

lines.speaker: speaker
lines.text: The hall has bread to spare.

lines.speaker: speaker
lines.text: Thank the officials for the grain.

lines.speaker: speaker
lines.text: I saw the mark of Renffr in the stars tonight… the harvest will be plentiful.

lines.speaker: speaker
lines.text: Did you see it? Renffr — written across the sky!

lines.speaker: speaker
lines.text: The letters fell apart… what does Renffr want?

lines.speaker: speaker
lines.text: My grandmother spoke of Renffr on nights like this.

lines.speaker: speaker
lines.text: Election next year — will {leader} keep the crown?

lines.speaker: speaker
lines.text: Well, I know one thing — {leader} has quite the reputation in town!

lines.speaker: speaker
lines.text: {leader} is defending — {candidateA} has the merit, I think.

lines.speaker: speaker
lines.text: Time for a fresh village head?

lines.speaker: speaker
lines.text: Prosperity favors {leader} — the stores are full.

lines.speaker: speaker
lines.text: Hard times hurt {leader} at the polls.

lines.speaker: speaker
lines.text: {leader} kept a clean name — that helps.

lines.speaker: speaker
lines.text: Folks blame {leader} for how bad things are.

lines.speaker: speaker
lines.text: Prosperity favors {leader} — the stores are full.

lines.speaker: speaker
lines.text: Hard times hurt {leader} at the polls.

lines.speaker: speaker
lines.text: {leader} kept a clean name — that helps.

lines.speaker: speaker
lines.text: Folks blame {leader} for how bad things are.

lines.speaker: speaker
lines.text: I must speak to the hall…

lines.speaker: partner_a
lines.text: I'll sweep the hearth if you investigate the mysterious scratching under the porch.

lines.speaker: partner_b
lines.text: Last time you investigated a scratching, you befriended a badger.

lines.speaker: partner_a
lines.text: His name was Barnaby and he had excellent table manners.

lines.speaker: partner_a
lines.text: You were snoring so loudly the ceiling rafters were vibrating.

lines.speaker: partner_b
lines.text: I wasn't snoring. I was harmonizing with the wind in the chimney.

lines.speaker: partner_a
lines.text: The wind doesn't gasp for air every thirty seconds.

lines.speaker: partner_a
lines.text: You stole my side of the bench by the fire.

lines.speaker: partner_b
lines.text: I was merely keeping the cushion warm so you wouldn't suffer.

lines.speaker: partner_a
lines.text: Such selfless devotion. Now scoot over.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: I drew our family with charcoal on this slate!

lines.speaker: parent
lines.text: Oh, that's lovely! Why does your father look like a hairy turnip with legs?

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Because realism is important to my artistic vision.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: I can't go to sleep yet. The shadow on the wall looks like a goblin with a fork.

lines.speaker: parent
lines.text: That is literally just your coat hanging on the wooden peg.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Then my coat has hostile intentions.

lines.speaker: parent
lines.text: Eat three more roasted carrots and you can go play in the yard.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: What if I eat two and compromise by looking very healthy?

lines.speaker: parent
lines.text: Three carrots, or I tell the village elder you hate farming.

lines.speaker: parent
lines.text: Where are your second pair of wool socks?

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: They are currently serving as winter mittens for my pet frog.

lines.speaker: parent
lines.text: The frog that lives outside in the mud?

lines.speaker: housemate_a
lines.text: Someone ate the bowl of dried berries I left covered on the shelf.

lines.speaker: housemate_b
lines.text: They were sitting there looking lonely and vulnerable to mold.

lines.speaker: housemate_a
lines.text: I covered them with a wooden plate and wrote 'MINE' in chalk.

lines.speaker: housemate_b
lines.text: I thought it said 'MINT'. I was testing for herbal freshness.

lines.speaker: housemate_a
lines.text: Why is the window shutter propped open when it's freezing outside?

lines.speaker: housemate_b
lines.text: The cabin smelled like boiled cabbage.

lines.speaker: housemate_a
lines.text: Now it smells like boiled cabbage and frostbite.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: Nobody here to steal the wool blanket. I am the undisputed emperor of this mattress.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: Eating stew directly out of the cooking pot with a big spoon. Civilization has peaked.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: Spider in the corner: you eat the pantry moths, I don't crush you with a boot. An honorable treaty.

lines.speaker: hunter
lines.text: If we don't bag something before sundown, I'm starting to eye my own left boot.

lines.speaker: starving_villager
lines.text: Leave the boot. Leather's apparently good for the joints.

lines.speaker: hunter
lines.text: Stay sharp. Tracks fresh near the creek – probably just a hare, but my stomach doesn't discriminate.

lines.speaker: starving_villager
lines.text: I miss the taste of anything that wasn't bark or regret.

lines.speaker: forager
lines.text: Three berries. Three! A very determined squirrel could outpace this harvest.

lines.speaker: starving_villager
lines.text: At least they're blue. Like the sky we're too hollow to appreciate.

lines.speaker: forager
lines.text: I'm half-convinced blueberries are a village myth. Next you'll say hope is real.

lines.speaker: starving_villager
lines.text: Don't jinx it. Hope's the only thing keeping us from gnawing the fence posts.

lines.speaker: starving_villager
lines.text: My stomach's making sounds that would scare a ghost. I'd trade my left shoe for a rotten turnip.

lines.speaker: forager
lines.text: Picking berries is easy. Finding berries that aren't just sad and small… that's the real challenge.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: I'm so happy to be a dad! Terrified, but happy!

lines.speaker: expectant_mother
lines.text: I don't walk anymore. I simply exert gravitational pull in a forward direction.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: I just folded 60 cloth diapers. I am either ready for a baby or opening a car wash.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: I sanded this wooden rattle for four hours. It is smoother than my own life choices.

lines.speaker: expectant_mother
lines.text: The baby is kicking up a storm tonight.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: Wait, did the baby kick? Or is that my heart palpitating at the thought of parenthood?

lines.speaker: expectant_mother
lines.text: That was definitely the baby. Your heart is just doing the cha-cha.

lines.speaker: expectant_mother
lines.text: I think the baby is practicing martial arts in there.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: A future village defender! Or a very tiny percussionist.

lines.speaker: expectant_mother
lines.text: Either way, my ribs are their favorite drum.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: I finished carving the cradle by the window.

lines.speaker: expectant_mother
lines.text: It's beautiful. Though I'm pretty sure you measured it for a hobbit.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: Hobbits are sturdy! It builds character. And saves on lumber.

lines.speaker: expectant_mother
lines.text: Soon we won't be sleeping through the night for a year.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: Nonsense. I've trained for this by staying up late. I am a machine of the night.

lines.speaker: expectant_mother
lines.text: A machine that cries when the fire goes out. We're doomed.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: There are currently eleven pillows in this bed and I am clinging to the edge of the mattress.

lines.speaker: expectant_mother
lines.text: The baby required a tactical pillow fortress.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: I am sleeping in a trench.

lines.speaker: expectant_mother
lines.text: Your sacrifice is noted and appreciated.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: Did the kitchen table move across the room, or am I dreaming?

lines.speaker: expectant_mother
lines.text: The feng shui was wrong for birth. The cupboard was giving off negative vibes.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: It's a wooden box with dry beans in it.

lines.speaker: expectant_mother
lines.text: I need pickles and honey. Together. Right now.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: I'll get the jar. Do we summon a wizard for this ritual or is the kitchen fine?

lines.speaker: expectant_mother
lines.text: Just the kitchen. And don't judge me.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: Never. I'm currently eating raw bread dough in solidarity.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: I've been thinking about names. What about 'Barnaby'?

lines.speaker: expectant_mother
lines.text: Barnaby? We are not naming our child after a 19th-century circus bear.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: Fine. What about 'Sir Barnaby the Brave'?

lines.speaker: expectant_mother
lines.text: I'm going to sleep in the barn.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: I don't know how to hold a baby. Do they come with a tutorial level?

lines.speaker: expectant_mother
lines.text: They come with a high-volume alarm and no mute button.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: Great. I'll go practice holding a watermelon. Wish me luck.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: I packed the emergency satchel: clean linen, herbal tea, and three lucky pebbles.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: In case we need to bribe a forest gnome for medical advice.

lines.speaker: neighbor
lines.text: If you carry high, it's a girl. If you carry low, it's a boy.

lines.speaker: expectant_mother
lines.text: I am currently carrying in all four cardinal directions.

lines.speaker: neighbor
lines.text: Ah. Congratulations on expecting a compass.
